explanation: The link starts at line 190, which is only the comment 'Set the value of the UI elements...'. The call to PolicyProcessing.GetPolicyState is on line 191 (Select Case PolicyProcessing.GetPolicyState(CurrentSource, CurrentSetting)). Move the start to line 191; the target (PolicyProcessing.vb:2) is right.

The definition's lines 143-147 declare only the five Friend WithEvents members (TextReg, TextBranch, TextRoot, ButtonBrowse, ButtonExport). Label1-Label4 are local variables of InitializeComponent declared at lines 25-28 and are not fields; their texts and TabIndex values are set at lines 40-74. Either drop the labels from the fields or cite the lines that declare them, so every field is declared as written within the definition's lines.

Lines 215-224 declare ten members; PolicyTypeLabel, PolicyStateLabel and CommentedLabel are locals declared at lines 25-27, outside the definition's lines. Also RequirementsBox is declared as 'Enabled False, TabIndex 8' but line 136 sets TabStop False too. Reconcile fields with lines (drop the label locals or cite their lines) and state the box's TabStop.

Lines 100-102 declare only KeyTextbox, ValueTextbox and SearchButton. KeyPathLabel and ValueLabel are locals declared at lines 25-26, outside the definition's lines. Drop them as fields or cite where they are declared.

says: The DoubleClickIgnoringTreeView.WndProc override is called by the Windows message loop (the host) with every window message, including the left-button double-click it swallows, yet its block has no entry point. Add an entry point on that block: started by another system (the Windows message loop), purpose: drops double-click messages so a tree box's displayed check state stays in step with its value.

Reads of data held elsewhere have no link. FindById.IdTextbox_TextChanged looks the typed ID up in AdmxWorkspace.FlatCategories, FlatProducts, SupportDefinitions and Policies (AdmxBundle.vb:11-17); FilterOptions.PresentDialog reads Workspace.Products (AdmxBundle.vb:15) to build the tree; EditSetting's list button handler reads ListEditor.FinalData after the dialog (ListEditor.vb:3). Add reads links from these call sites to those members.

The Searcher delegates built in FindByRegistry.SearchButton_Click (lambda) and FindByText.SearchButton_Click (lambda) hold the search rules (wildcard, quoted-phrase, key-path matching) and are run later by code outside these files, but are only covered by the enclosing click-handler block. Consider blocks for those anonymous functions (the registry search at 17-35, the text search at 24-71) so the rules and the PolicyProcessing link are attributed to the code that runs them.
